messages.text: Brightwave reports duplicate records after a failed sync. Filed LIN-155 and GitHub #88.
The idempotency key includes the attempt number, so a retry looks like a new write.
Confirmed: sync retries now max 4 with jitter (Brightwave hit rate limits during retry storms). Cap of 3 was rejected.
Will change the code; haven't touched LIN-142 or the spec. They still say 5.
Also require Idempotency-Key on POST /sync.

Header for signatures is X-Tidepool-Signature. Please stop writing X-Hub-Signature.
webhooks_v2 stays off until Nov 5. Owner is Tom.
